title: Lead Generation, Cold Calling & Appointment Setter
description:
Company: New World Digital Agency  

Position: Lead Generation & Appointment Setter  

Location: Remote  

Schedule: Evening / Night shift

Trial Period: 2 months  

Language: English required. French is an asset.



## About the Role



New World Digital Agency is looking for a motivated, organized, and results-driven person to support our lead generation, cold calling, and appointment setting activities.



Your role will be to contact business owners and decision-makers, validate the qualification criteria, and book appointments with interested and qualified prospects.



The agency may also provide leads, and part of your role will be to manage those leads properly, follow up, and keep the CRM updated.



## Main Responsibilities



- Contact business owners and decision-makers

- Manage leads provided by the agency

- Generate new business leads when needed

- Research and qualify prospects

- Make outbound cold calls

- Ask qualification questions

- Book qualified appointments

- Follow up with interested prospects

- Clearly update lead status and notes in the CRM



## Compensation



This position starts with a 2-month trial period.



During the trial period, compensation is performance-based:



- 500 CAD/month base pay, activated once the agent reaches 20 qualified appointments per month

- 10 CAD per qualified appointment booked

- 15 CAD bonus if the deal is closed

- Additional performance bonuses may be available after reaching 40, 50, and 60 qualified appointments per month



After the 2-month trial period, if performance is strong and consistent, there will be a possibility to move to:



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



- Comfortable with lead generation and cold calling

- Confident speaking in English

- Available to work evening/night shifts aligned with Canadian business hours

- Professional and polite with prospects

- Organized and consistent

- Able to follow a script and process

- Good at updating lead notes and statuses

- Motivated by results and commissions



Experience in lead generation, cold calling, appointment setting, sales, BPO, or call center work is a strong asset.

title: Financial Advisor / Bookkeeper (Business + Personal Support)
description:
I’m seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Financial Advisor / Bookkeeper to support both my business and personal finances. This role is for someone who doesn’t just track numbers—but helps me understand them, plan with them, and make better decisions because of them.



I need someone who is confident in their work, good at what they do, and able to explain finances clearly, calmly, and without jargon.



This is a collaborative role with frequent meetings (weekly or bi-weekly). I’m looking for someone who takes initiative, flags issues before they become problems, and actively brings insights to the table.

Oversee all financial aspects of my business



Payroll management



Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks



Separate and monitor business vs. personal finances



Monitor business and personal bank accounts



Cash flow tracking and forecasting



Credit card tracking, budgeting, and payoff strategy



Expense review and cost control (flag unnecessary spending)



Employee cost analysis (hours, staffing, hiring decisions)



Monthly and quarterly financial summaries



Translate financial data into clear, actionable insights



Proactively flag anything that looks off or risky



Participate in weekly or bi-weekly financial check-ins



Help me plan toward financial goals with clarity and confidence



What I’m Looking For



Experience supporting small businesses



Strong knowledge of QuickBooks and Excel



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable



Self-directed and proactive (you don’t wait to be asked)



Comfortable discussing both business and personal finances

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
READ HOW TO APPLY OR YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED



Security Engineer - (Remote) | Full-Time

Company: Ekim IT Solutions | Portland, Maine, USA

Hours: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM Eastern (Mon-Fri) 

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience (Range is $12-$15hr)



Who We Are

Ekim IT Solutions is a fast-growing, dental-specialized managed service provider based in Maine. We are the preferred IT partner of the Maine Dental Association and we serve dental practices across the Northeast and beyond. We are not a generic MSP. We are specialists, and we operate with discipline, speed, and a standard most MSPs in our market can't touch.

We are growing fast and we need someone who can keep up.



The Role

We are looking for a Security Engineer who is an absolute force on the ticket queue.

This is not a button-pressing job. This is not for someone who escalates everything and waits to be told what to do. We need a technician who owns problems start to finish, thinks two steps ahead, and makes our boots-on-the-ground team in the US faster and more effective, not more dependent.

You will be the first line of fire every morning when our dental office managers arrive and start submitting issues. You will triage, resolve, escalate intelligently, and document, before most of our US team even has their coffee.

Your job is to make every other person on this team feel like they have a superpower.



Your Responsibilities



Own the ticket queue during your shift, triage, prioritize, and resolve with urgency

Handle Tier 2 and Tier 3 issues independently: networking, server, endpoint, M365, security, dental software integration

Support our on-site US engineers remotely , be the brain when they need one

Identify patterns in recurring issues and build toward permanent fixes, not band-aids

Maintain and contribute to our documentation in Hudu , if it isn't documented, fix that

Streamline internal processes , if something is inefficient, call it out and fix it

Communicate clearly with clients and internal team in written English





What You Must Have



10+ years of hands-on IT experience, with significant time inside a managed service provider

CCNA certification minimum , higher certifications (CCNP, MCSE, etc.) are a strong advantage

Deep experience with Microsoft 365 administration and security (Conditional Access, Entra ID, Defender, Exchange)

Strong Windows Server background , Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, Hyper-V

Solid networking fundamentals , VLANs, routing, firewall policy, VPN

Experience working with RMM and PSA platforms in an MSP environment

Excellent written and spoken English , you will interface directly with clients via phone and in writing, and will be expected to handle client calls independently over time





Bonus Points



Familiarity with any of our stack: HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, Huntress, Hudu, Axcient, Domotz, UniFi

Experience with dental practice software (Eaglesoft, Dentrix, Curve, Sidexis, Dexis)

Experience supporting HIPAA-compliant environments

Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS





What to Expect

Week 1: You get acquainted with our systems, our clients, our stack, and our standards. We will invest in getting you up to speed.

Week 2 onward: You are expected to show value. We will know quickly if you are the right person.

We are direct. If something isn't working, we will tell you. If you are performing, we will reward it. We are a strong team that works hard, communicates well, and takes care of each other. If you want a place where your skills are actually used and recognized, this is it.



What We Offer



Unlimited paid time off , we measure output, not hours

A team that actually values you , high standards go both ways; if you perform, you will be recognized and rewarded

Work with a specialized, fast-moving MSP that is ahead of the curve , not a stagnant shop with stale processes





A Word of Honesty

We have worked with talented engineers from the Philippines before and we are proud of those relationships. We are also being straight with you: we have had people attempt to coast , collect a paycheck, do the minimum, and treat this like easy money.

If that is what you are looking for, we are not the right fit and we would rather you know that now.



We work hard. We move fast. We hold each other to a high standard. If you want a place where that energy is matched and rewarded, you will thrive here. If you are looking for easy money, we can save you the trouble.



How to Apply

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.



Please include a link to your resume for review.

# Sales Closer (Remote) — Web Design, SEO, PPC + Digital Services



## About Us



Zino Web is a US-based digital marketing agency helping small and medium-sized businesses grow through professional website design, SEO, PPC advertising, and related marketing services.



We are looking for an experienced **Sales Closer** to join our remote team. This is not an appointment-setting role. You will speak with qualified prospects, understand their business needs, present our services, handle objections, follow up, and close deals.



## What You’ll Do



* Take booked sales calls from inbound leads and warm prospects

* Follow up with leads by
, phone, SMS, and CRM tasks

* Present Zino Web services clearly: web design, SEO, PPC, and marketing solutions

* Ask strong discovery questions and identify the client’s real business problem

* Handle objections around price, timing, trust, and decision-making

* Close deals and help move clients to onboarding

* Keep the CRM updated with notes, next steps, deal stage, and follow-up dates

* Stay responsive during your full shift

* Attend tea
etings, sales training, and role-play sessions



## Requirements



* Proven experience closing sales, preferably for digital marketing, websites, SEO, PPC, SaaS, or B2B services

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident on Zoom/Google Meet and phone calls

* Reliable internet connection

* Quality headset or microphone

* Quiet work environment

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Comfortable working with targets and commissions

* Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Los Angeles time

* Must be responsive throughout the shift



## Nice-to-Haves



* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM

* Experience selling to US business owners

* Knowledge of web design, SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or marketing funnels

* Experience with Zoom, Google Meet, Slack, Gmail, and online calendars



## Schedule / Time Zone



* Monday to Friday

* 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time / Los Angeles time

* Full-time remote role

* You must be comfortable working this shift consistently



## Pay / Benefits



* Base pay: **$500–$800/month**, depending on experience

* Commission: earned on closed deals after client payment is received

* Realistic commission structure: **3%–7% per closed sale**, based on package type and performance

* Performance reviews after training and every 60–90 days

* Long-term growth opportunity for strong closers



## KPIs We Track



* Follow-up speed: respond to new leads within 5–10 minutes during shift

* Show rate support: confirm calls and reduce no-shows

* Close rate on qualified calls

* CRM hygiene: all leads updated daily

* Follow-up completion rate

* Monthly closed revenue



## Training / Onboarding



We provide **1 month of paid training**. During training, you will learn our services, offers, sales process, CRM workflow, scripts, objection handling, and follow-up system.



Success looks like this:



**30 days:** You understand our services, scripts, CRM, and sales process.

**60 days:** You are confidently handling calls, following up, and closing smaller deals.

**90 days:** You are consistently closing qualified prospects and managing your pipeline independently.



## Do Not Apply If



* You only have appointment-setting experience and no closing experience

* You are not comfortable speaking with US business owners

* You cannot work 9 AM–5 PM Los Angeles time

* You are not responsive during work hours

* You have poor internet, background noise, or no quality headset

* You avoid CRM updates or follow-up tasks



## How to Apply



Send your application with the subject line:



**ZINO CLOSER**



Include the following:



* A short introduction about your sales experience

* A 1–2 minute voice recording link explaining why you are a good fit

* Your top 2 sales closes, including what you sold and the deal value

* Screenshot of your internet speed test

* Your expected monthly base pay

* Your availability in Pacific Time



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

7 AM to 7 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Use company macros/templates while still sounding human

Look up basic customer/order information when needed

Order status questions

Basic product questions

Return process questions

Refunds

General website/live chat inquiries

Technical installation confusion

Address changes after order placement

Any situation where you are unsure what to say

Requirements



The ideal candidate must have:

Excellent written English

Customer support experience

Zendesk experience preferred

Live chat experience preferred

E-commerce experience preferred

Shopify experience is a plus

Strong attention to detail

Calm and professional writing style

Reliable internet connection

Ability to work independently

Ability to follow company policies carefully

Comfortable with U.S. Pacific Time coverage

Comfortable with 7-day flexible coverage

Important Personality Traits

Reliable

Honest

Detail-oriented

Calm under pressure

Good with upset customers

Professional but friendly

Careful with company policies

Comfortable asking questions

Able to work long-term without needing constant supervision



This role is not just about answering tickets quickly. We need someone who can protect the customer experience while also following company policies.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a phone support role.

This is not a sales cold-calling role.

This is not a short-term project.

This is not a nonstop 8-hour desk job.

This is not a role where you can ignore notifications for several hours.



The active workload is light to moderate, but responsiveness is important.



Daily Expectations



A typical day may look like this:



Check Zendesk in the morning for new tickets

Reply to simple customer questions

Monitor live chat notifications

Check Zendesk every 30–60 minutes during the coverage window

Handle easy tickets as they come in

We are open to both full-time and part-time roles, minimum 20hrs. Please only apply if serious experience managing at least €250k/month brand.



We're a fast-growing eCommerce brand with our own warehouse and factory in the Netherlands. 2-3x year on year growth for 5 years straight with 100k+ customers.



We sell houseplant-specific products across Europe and are now scaling our Amazon EU + UK hard. We grew Amazon from €0 to ~€80k revenue per month in just a few months, and we're looking for someone to help us hit €300k/month within the next 12 months.



Amazon is a new & critical growth channel for us, and we're looking for someone to take full operational ownership. We have a dedicated PPC manager handling our core markets, now we need an operator who can run the engine end-to-end.

Our Mission

At Sybotanica, a small, high-growth startup, we wake up every day to make plants happy! To do that, we need to act fast, take ownership, and take pride in our work as a team.

If we succeed, we'll become Europe's #1 houseplant brand, and we'll know we've made it when we can proudly call 500,000 plant lovers our customers.

You will be working closely with the founder, our PPC manager, our Supply Chain Manager, and the rest of our 20-person team (including 10 PH-based employees).

Working Hours: available during EU business hours (08:00–17:00 Amsterdam time).

What You'll Be Responsible For

You own Amazon operations end-to-end across EU + UK marketplaces, catalogue, product launches, and PPC for a defined set of markets.



1. Catalogue Management & Listing Operations

- Build and maintain listings across 4 main product categories in 5+ countries (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, plus expansion markets)

- Title, bullets, description, backend keyword, A+ Content and Brand Story updates

- Running A/B testing via Manage Your Experiments

- Variation/parent-child structure setup and maintenance

- Flat file uploads, bulk edits, attribute corrections

- Listing suppression and Buy Box issue resolution



2. Product Launches

- New ASIN launches and product launches across countries

- Launch planning, coordination, and execution from setup to live



3. PPC for Secondary Markets

- Own PPC end-to-end for a few defined markets (e.g. IT, ES, FR), while the PPC manager focuses on the core markets

The goal: free up the PPC manager to focus deeply on the biggest markets while you keep the secondary markets running well



4. EU + UK Compliance & Catalogue Health

- Responsible for account health ratings



5. Cross-functional Coordination

- Work closely with the PPC manager (listing changes affect ad performance, and PPC needs to stay aligned across the markets you each own)

- Coordinate with the Supply Chain Manager on new launches and stock planning

- Coordinate with the founder on brand direction and priorities (We do NOT need a brand strategist, founder acts as that role)



Requirements (Read Carefully)

- Deep Amazon knowledge, multi year experience. 

- Hands-on PPC experience 

- Hands-on experience with Brand Registry, A+ Content, flat files, and variation management

- Multi-marketplace experience (especially EU) strongly preferred

- 
 or other EU marketplace experience is a strong plus

- Experience setting up Shopify ? Amazon (or Shopify ? other marketplace) integrations yourself is a strong plus

- You're excited to work in a fast-moving, remote-friendly team where ownership and initiative are valued



Perks & Benefits

- 13th-month pay (pro-rated if yearly); 14th-month based on company performance

- Flexible work hours (starting part-time also on the table)

- Raises based on KPI targets every 6–12 months

- 28 paid leave days per year

- Real-life team events with our PH team!



To Apply, Send a short message explaining:



The proof outlined above. The more the better.

- Detailed specifications of size of Amazon account(s) handled: annual revenue, # of ASINs, marketplaces, what parts you were responsible for + results you delivered

- PPC results you've personally driven (ACOS, TACOS, revenue scaled)

- Before/after examples of listings you've optimized (screenshots welcome!)

- Any Shopify ? marketplace integrations you've set up yourself, what tools used and details of challenges faced. 

- Your CV in .PDF

- What motivates you

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist
description:
Acquisition Sales Agent – Real Estate Wholesaling

JC Investment Strategies | Remote | Full-Time



About the Role

We are seeking a driven and experienced Acquisition Sales Agent to join our growing real estate wholesaling operation. This is a high-activity, performance-focused role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment and has a deep understanding of the wholesaling process from first contact through signed contract.



Key Responsibilities

 • Conduct high-volume outbound calling (up to 1,000 dials per day) to motivated seller leads

 • Accurately disposition calls within the CRM to maintain a clean, organized pipeline

 • Qualify leads by assessing seller motivation, property condition, and deal viability

 • Calculate and present Maximum Allowable Offers (MAO) using standard wholesaling formulas

 • Follow up consistently with leads and prospects to move deals through the pipeline

 • Build rapport with sellers and confidently guide them toward executing a purchase agreement

 • Secure a minimum of 4 potential deals per month by converting qualified leads into signed purchase agreements

 • Maintain detailed records of all outreach activity and lead status



Requirements

 • Proven experience in real estate wholesaling (as an agent, acquisition rep, or similar role)

 • Hands-on experience with power dialers or high-volume outbound calling platforms

 • Strong understanding of wholesaling fundamentals, including ARV, MAO, and deal structuring

 • Demonstrated ability to consistently close and secure a minimum of 4 deals per month

 • Excellent communication and closing skills — you know how to build trust and create urgency

 • Highly organized with the ability to manage and disposition a large volume of leads daily

 • Self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment



Preferred Qualifications

 • Experience with the DealMachine platform

 • Familiarity with CallTools or similar dialer systems

 • Prior experience working with a wholesaling team or investment company



Compensation

 • Base pay + performance-based bonuses (details provided during interview)



To apply, please submit your resume along with a brief overview of your wholesaling experience and any deals you’ve been involved in closing.

title: Virtual CFO - Paradigm Zone
description:
Virtual CFO (Part-Time Trial, Potential Full-Time Role)



Location: Remote (Adelaide Time Zone)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM (1:00–2:00 PM break)

Trial Duration: 2 Weeks (Part-Time)



*Application Requirement*



Please attach a short personalized video (1–2 minutes) explaining why you believe you’re a good fit for this role and how your skills align with the responsibilities below. Applications without a video will not be considered.



About Us



We are an Australian group of businesses in the entertainment and technology space. We are growing, expanding into new locations, and building out a B2B technology arm. We need a Virtual CFO who can take full ownership of our financial operations so leadership can focus on growing the business.



What This Role Is



This is not a bookkeeping role. This is a senior, hands on position where you will own everything financial across multiple entities. You will be trusted with full visibility and decision making authority over budgets, forecasting, and reporting. The goal is simple: leadership should never have to think about money management because you are already on top of it.



What You Will Own



 • Full management and oversight of all financial accounts across multiple entities

 • Building and maintaining monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

 • Setting clear spending allocations and revenue targets each month

 • Cash flow forecasting and runway management

 • Expense categorisation, review, and optimisation. Identifying waste, flagging anomalies, renegotiating contracts where needed

 • Monthly financial reporting in a clear, executive ready format covering P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, and key KPIs

 • Tax planning coordination with our Australian accountant

 • Financial modelling for new initiatives, expansion plans, and capital expenditure

 • Vendor payment management and reconciliation

 • Working with our existing finance dashboard and reporting systems



What Success Looks Like



After 90 days, leadership should be able to ask you any financial question and get an accurate answer within a few hours. Leadership should not need to log into accounts or chase invoices. There should be complete clarity on spending capacity at any given 
nt because you have already mapped it out.



Who You Are



 • 5+ years experience as a CFO, Finance Manager, or senior financial controller

 • Experience with SME or multi-entity finance

 • CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred

 • Experience with Australian accounting standards and tax preferred, or willingness to learn quickly

 • Comfortable with hospitality, retail, or entertainment industry finance

 • Highly proficient with Xero, QuickBooks, or similar accounting platforms

 • Excellent written and verbal English communication

 • Self-directed, proactive, able to work with minimal supervision

 • Trustworthy and discreet with sensitive financial information



Working Arrangement



 • Full time, remote from the Philippines

 • Reporting directly to the CEO

 • Weekly check ins and monthly financial review meetings

 • Long term role with growth potential as the business expands



How to Apply



Send the following:



 1. Your CV

 2. A short note on why this role suits you

 3. One example of a time you took messy or scattered finances and turned them into a clear, structured system

 4. Your expected monthly salary in USD or PHP



We will only respond to applications that include all four items.

title: Graphic Designer & Visual Innovator (AI-Fluent)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Experience Level: Mid-to-Senior level



Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled, visionary Graphic Designer based in the Philippines to join our creative team. This is not a role for a simple asset producer; we need a true creative partner who actively stays ahead of visual trends, challenges the status quo, and sets new standards for our clients.



The ideal candidate blends high-level artistic mastery across digital, web, and print mediums with modern tech-fluency—specifically utilizing AI design tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries. If you are a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, takes absolute ownership of deadlines, and brings fresh, innovative ideas to the table, we want you.



Key Responsibilities

Comprehensive Visual Design: Develop and elevate cohesive brand identities (logos, typography, style guides, and marketing collaterals) alongside clean, striking graphics for websites.



Digital & Social Media: Create high-converting, trend-forward graphics for social media campaigns across various platforms.



Print & Collateral: Design premium print layouts, brochures, presentation decks, and multi-format physical assets.



Trend Leadership: Continuously research and integrate emerging design movements to ensure client work looks cutting-edge and distinct.



AI Workflow Integration: Leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, Firefly, Canva AI, etc.) to accelerate brainstorming, iterate concepts rapidly, and elevate final outputs.



Project Ownership: Manage multiple design projects from concept to final delivery, ensuring every single deadline is strictly met with zero hand-holding.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Portfolio: A diverse, stunning portfolio showcasing mastery in branding, digital layouts, social media assets, and print design. (Applications without a portfolio will not be considered).



Software Expertise: Advanced proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) or equivalent industry-standard design tools.



AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into a professional creative workflow to enhance output quality and speed.



Soft Skills: Exceptional time management, a strong sense of urgency regarding deadlines, and a proactive attitude that anticipates project needs.



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for seamless collaboration on design directions.



Compensation & Benefits

Probationary Rate (Months 1–3): $650 USD per month, paid out weekly at $162.50 USD every Friday.



Post-Probationary Rate (Month 4+): Upon successful completion of the 90-day trial, your compensation will increase to $1,000 USD per month, paid out weekly at $250 USD every Friday.



Payment Schedule: Reliable, guaranteed payouts every single Friday via a global payment platform.



Work Structure: 100% remote, full-time position with creative freedom.



How to Apply

To apply for this role, please submit your application with the following four elements.



Resume & Portfolio Link: A link to your live portfolio (Behance, Adobe Portfolio, or personal website) showcasing your work.



The Trend Test: In 2–3 sentences, tell us about a current graphic design trend you love right now, and one trend you think is completely played out.



AI Integration: Briefly explain which AI generative or design tools you currently use in your workflow to speed up your creative process or elevate your final outputs.



Attention to Detail Check: To prove you read this entire job posting, please start the very first line of your application by telling us your favorite food or favorite animal.



(Note: Applications that do not include their favorite food or animal in the opening line will be automatically archived without review).

title: 3D Modeling/CAD Designer
description:
Speed Industries is looking for a skilled Virtual Assistant with strong 3D modeling and CAD design experience to support our fabrication, laser cutting, powder coating, and product development work.



This role is ideal for someone who understands manufacturing, can take rough ideas or marked-up drawings and turn them into clean, usable CAD files, and can help reduce the design workload for our internal team. The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and comfortable working remotely with a fast-moving fabrication company.



The primary focus of this position will be creating, revising, and preparing 3D models, 2D drawings, flat patterns, and production-ready design files for manufacturing.



Key Responsibilities

3D Modeling & CAD Design



Create and revise 3D models for fabricated parts, assemblies, brackets, guards, frames, fixtures, signs, and customer products.



Develop CAD models from sketches, photos, measurements, customer drawings, or verbal direction.



Prepare clean and accurate part files for CNC laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and powder coating.



Create and update 2D drawings with dimensions, notes, material callouts, bend details, hole sizes, tolerances, and revision history.



Generate flat patterns, DXF files, STEP files, PDF drawings, and other required production files.



Assist with converting customer-supplied files into usable manufacturing drawings.



Check designs for manufacturability, including bend allowances, material thickness, hole spacing, weld access, hardware clearance, and powder coating considerations.



Drawing Packages & Revisions



Prepare professional drawing packages for shop use and customer approval.



Revise existing drawings based on feedback from customers, shop employees, or management.



Maintain organized file naming, folder structure, and version control.



Clearly mark changes and communicate revision updates.



Help standardize Speed Fabrication’s drawing templates, title blocks, notes, and CAD file organization.



Manufacturing Support



Work with Speed Fabrication’s team to help translate ideas into buildable products.



Support laser cutting, fabrication, and powder coating projects with accurate CAD files.



Assist with product development for online products, Shopify items, Etsy products, customer jobs, and repeat manufacturing work.



Identify potential design issues before parts reach the shop floor.



Help create repeatable designs that improve efficiency and reduce rework.



Required Skills



Strong experience with 3D CAD software such as:



Fusion 360

SolidWorks

Inventor

AutoCAD

Onshape

or similar professional CAD software



Ability to create accurate 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.



Ability to export DXF, STEP, PDF, STL, and other common file types.



Understanding of sheet metal design, bend lines, flat patterns, material thickness, and formed parts.



Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.



Strong attention to detail.



Good written communication skills.



Ability to follow directions, ask smart questions, and work independently.



Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely.



Ability to organize files clearly and consistently.



Preferred Experience



Experience designing parts for CNC laser cutting.



Experience with press brake forming and sheet metal fabrication.



Experience with tube laser or structural fabrication.



Experience creating weldment drawings or fabrication assemblies.



Experience designing products for powder coating.



Experience working with American units: inches, fractions, decimals, gauges, and material thicknesses.



Experience creating customer approval drawings.



Experience with manufacturing businesses, job shops, or custom fabrication companies.



Basic understanding of hardware, fasteners, weld symbols, tabs, slots, bend reliefs, and tolerances.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is not just a CAD operator. They are someone who thinks through how a part will actually be made.



They should be able to take an idea like, “We need a bracket that bolts here and holds this panel,” and turn it into a clean model and drawing that the shop can manufacture with minimal back-and-forth.



They should be organized, responsive, and capable of working with limited information while still knowing when to ask questions.



Typical Projects



Examples of work may include:



Sheet metal brackets

Laser-cut parts

Welded assemblies

Guards and covers

Custom signs

Product prototypes

Customer-supplied drawing cleanup

DXF file preparation

Fixtures and shop tooling

Repeat manufacturing parts

Assembly drawings

Flat patterns for laser cutting and bending

Software Requirements



Candidate should have access to professional CAD software or be willing to work within Speed Fabrication’s preferred CAD workflow.



Preferred software: Fusion 360, but other platforms may be acceptable depending on experience and file compatibility.



Required export formats:



DXF

STEP

PDF

STL when needed

Native CAD files when applicable

Communication & Workflow



This is a remote position. Communication may happen through
, phone, text, shared folders, project management software, or video calls.



The candidate must be able to:



Review project instructions

Ask clarifying questions

Provide estimated completion times

Submit clean files

Make revisions quickly

Keep files organized

Communicate when something is unclear or not manufacturable

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, speed, accuracy, and ability to produce manufacturing-ready work.



Possible structures include:



Hourly

Per project

Part-time contract

Trial period with growth potential

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy of CAD models and drawings

Speed of turnaround

Low number of revision errors

Clear communication

Ability to understand fabrication requirements

Clean file organization

Ability to reduce workload from Speed Fabrication’s internal team

Ability to create files that can move directly into production

title: Short-Form Video Editor | TikTok Style
description:
Who We Are



We're one of the fastest-growing travel jewelry brands in the US, and we want you to become part of our editing team, a global team of talent from all over the world. High pay, real creative ownership, no micromanaging.



Most of our editors have been with us for over a year and a half. This is a long-term partnership, not a gig. Our top editors earn $1,000–$2,000+/month, every month.



Exchange Life sells collectible country flag charms, keychains, bracelets, and necklaces for travelers. We run a fully remote team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across time zones, and we treat our people like long-term partners, not freelancers.



What You'll Do



- Edit short-form content that actually performs. TikTok and Reels. Hook, pacing, captions, B-roll, sound design. Fast cuts built to stop the scroll.

- Think in metrics, not just aesthetics. Hook rate, watch time, and retention are your creative compass. You study what's working and apply it to every edit.

- Collaborate on new concepts with the marketing team. Test new angles, iterate on winning formats, and help shape what the brand looks like at scale.

- Ship fast and stay consistent. No hand-holding needed. You communicate clearly, turn around content quickly, and own your work.



You're a Fit If...



- You have at least one TikTok or Reel that crossed 500K views in the last 2 months, and you can explain exactly what made it work

- Your portfolio has 10+ short-form edits from the last 30 days (TikTok or Reels only)

- You think in hook rate, retention, and watch time, not just that something looks “pretty”

- You're highly proficient in CapCut Pro, or any other editing tool you use.

- You deliver fast, communicate clearly in English, and don't need check-ins to stay on track



This Isn't for You If...



- Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or wedding/event content

- You can't point to a recent video that went viral and explain why

- You're looking for a short-term gig

- You need a fixed schedule or regular supervision to stay productive



Compensation



Base rate: 615 PHP /hr, approximately 35 hours a week, with a fully flexible schedule (you work whenever you want as long as you respect deadlines).



Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid for viral videos and winning ad creatives.



Constant Feedback Loop & Training: You're never left to guess. Our team helps you grow fast and makes sure you're always working on the right things.



This is a long-term role. We invest in people who are committed and want to keep getting better. We'll literally pay you to improve: courses, 1-on-1 mentorship, we want you to become the best at what you do and be part of your journey!



How to Apply

Takes about 5 minutes. We check every application.

You should be comfortable translating technical processes into easy-to-manage solutions for a

and scheduling efficiency.

description:

title: Amazon VA + Customer Service Specialist
description:
Overview



We are looking for a highly reliable, professional, and experienced **Amazon Virtual Assistant with strong Customer Service experience** to join our growing eCommerce team.

We are looking for a proactive “closer” — someone who can manage Amazon-related tasks, handle customer concerns professionally, protect seller metrics, and support the overall health of the account.



---



## Job Requirements — Non-Negotiable



**Location:**

Applicant must be currently living in **Metro Manila or Cebu only**. Applicants outside these locations will not be considered.



**Experience:**

Minimum of **2 years of straight, consecutive experience** as an **Amazon VA and/or Amazon Customer Service Specialist**.



We are looking for stable work history, not job-hopping experience.



Accepted examples:



* Company X: Jan 2023 – Present

* Company Y: Feb 2022 – Feb 2024



Not accepted:



* 3 months in one company, 6 months in another company, then another short contract.



**Amazon Seller Central Knowledge:**

Must have hands-on experience navigating Amazon Seller Central, including buyer messages, account health, orders, returns, refunds, cases, and basic Amazon operations.



**Customer Service Experience:**

Must have experience handling Amazon buyer messages, customer complaints, refunds, returns, damaged/missing items, “delivered but not received” cases, cancellations, negative feedback, and customer escalations.



**Autonomy:**

Must be confident working independently, following SOPs, making sound decisions, and resolving issues without constant supervision.



**Availability:**

Must be willing to work **40 hours per week on Pacific Time / US night shift**.



**Work Setup:**

Must have a stable internet connection, backup internet preferred, and a quiet professional working environment.



**Communication Skills:**

Must be professional, clear, and calm when communicating with customers and internal tea
mbers.



---



## Scope of Work



### Amazon VA / Seller Central Support



* Monitor Seller Central notifications, account health alerts, and performance issues.

* Check stranded inventory, suppressed listings, listing errors, and catalog issues.

* Assist with opening, tracking, and following up on Amazon support cases.

* Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock or out-of-stock risks.

* Download and organize Amazon reports when needed.

* Update listings, pricing, images, backend keywords, or product details based on instructions.

* Help maintain clean and accurate product information.

* Support FBA/FBM order and inventory-related tasks.



---



### Amazon Customer Service Support



* Manage Amazon buyer messages professionally and within Amazon response time requirements.

* Handle refunds, returns, cancellations, damaged items, missing items, and “delivered but not received” cases.

* Make refund or replacement recommendations based on company SOPs.

* Prevent unnecessary escalations to A-to-Z claims or chargebacks.

* Handle A-to-Z claims, chargebacks, and disputes carefully to help protect seller metrics.

* Monitor negative feedback and product reviews.

* Assist with professional outreach and feedback removal requests when allowed by Amazon policy.

* Maintain a calm, professional, and customer-focused communication style.



---



## In Your Application, Please Explain / Confirm:



1. Your current location: **Metro Manila or Cebu only**.

2. Your exact Amazon work experience and consecutive work dates.

3. Your hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.

4. The Amazon tasks you handled before, such as listings, inventory, cases, reports, buyer messages, refunds, or returns.

5. How you handle negative feedback and your process for requesting removal.

6. How you prevent customer issues from escalating to A-to-Z claims.

7. Your experience d
 or recommending refunds/replacements based on SOPs.

8. Your availability to work **40 hours per week on Pacific Time / US night shift**.

9. Confirmation that you have a stable internet connection and quiet work setup.



---



## How to Apply — The Test



To confirm that you have read the full job description, include the keyword **PACIFIC40** in the subject line of your message.



Applications without the keyword in the subject line, applicants outside **Metro Manila or Cebu**, or applicants who do not meet the **2-year straight Amazon experience requirement** will be automatically declined.



---



## Ideal Candidate Profile



**Detail-Oriented:**

You catch small issues before they become bigger problems.



**Customer-Focused:**

You know how to communicate professionally, calm customers down, and resolve concerns properly.



**Process-Driven:**

You can follow SOPs and understand the importance of protecting seller metrics, account health, and customer experience.



**Reliable & Stable:**

You show up consistently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work.



**Proactive Problem Solver:**

You do not wait for every small instruction. You identify issues, suggest solutions, and escalate only when needed.



**Advantage:**

Experience with Etsy, Walmart, Shopify, Amazon FBM/FBA operations, or previous Amazon-related call center work in the Philippines is a plus.



---



If you are an experienced **Amazon VA with strong customer service skills**, currently based in **Metro Manila or Cebu**, with at least **2 years of straight Amazon experience**, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Storyboard Artist for 3D Animated YouTube Shorts (Long-term, Zack D Films Style)
description:
I run a growing 3D animated faceless YouTube channel modeled on Zack D Films, and I'm hiring a long-term storyboard artist who is the bridge between the script and the final animated short. This is the most important hire on my team — the storyboard is what makes or breaks the video.



Main Responsibility — Storyboarding (60% of your time)

For every approved script you receive, you'll break it down into small sentences (one beat per frame) and turn it into a storyboard. For each sentence you'll provide:



A clear visual instruction (camera angle, character action, expression, environment)

A reference image (a screenshot from a similar Zack D Films short, a movie still, or a real photo — anything that shows the animator exactly what you mean)

Timing notes if the beat needs special pacing (slow zoom, hard cut, hold-for-laugh)

A 3D animator should be able to open your storyboard, look at sentence #14, and animate that frame without asking you a single question.



Voiceover Production (15%)

Use Elevenlabs to create the voice over then use Audacity to trim the VoiceOver with fullstops, etc.



Animator Feedback Loop (15%)

Once the 3D animators deliver a draft, you review it against the storyboard. If something is off — wrong camera angle, off timing, expression doesn't match the line — you write clear revision notes with timestamps and (where useful) annotated screenshots. You keep this loop running until the final video matches our quality bar.



Channel Management (10%)



Upload finished videos to YouTube with the right title, description, tags, thumbnail

Schedule uploads on our posting cadence

Reply to comments to drive engagement (you'll be given a tone guide)

Flag comments that need my attention (sponsorships, collabs, complaints)

You'll be given on Day 1: Full Zack D Films scripting SOP, reverse-engineered storyboard reference Zack D Films shorts, animator brief + revision-note templates, channel SOP, voiceover sample reels.



? BIG PLUS — 3D Animation Skills (Higher Pay)

If you can also do 3D animation (Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or similar), this is a major plus. I'll send 3D animation work your way on top of the storyboarding role, and your monthly salary goes up accordingly — see the salary breakdown below. If you're a strong storyboard artist AND a competent 3D animator, you're exactly who I want on this team long-term.



Who You Are:



You've worked on at least one animated YouTube channel before (unpaid passion projects count if the work is good)

Strong visual sense — when you read "he slowly opened the door," you immediately picture the angle, lighting, and lens

Clear, natural-sounding English. Voice samples required

You read briefs carefully and ask clarifying questions early instead of guessing

Available for one 30-minute video call per week

Can commit 6+ months. No 1-month contracts

What this job is NOT: You will not be writing scripts (we have a scriptwriter). You will not be doing the 3D animation (we have animators). You will not be designing thumbnails (we have a thumbnail designer). You will be the bridge between script and animation. That's the whole job.



HOW TO APPLY — follow this format exactly:



1. Start your message with the words "Frame 14" so I know you read the full post.

2. Portfolio: 1–3 links to storyboards or animated shorts you've worked on. If you don't have public examples, paste a 10-frame storyboard for this sentence: "I broke my brother's trophy and tried to hide it before he got home — but then I heard his key in the lock." Use any image references you want (Google Image links are fine).

3. Voice sample: A 30–60 second voiceover recording. Drive/Dropbox link, no attachments.

4. Zack D Films question: In 2–3 sentences, what makes a Zack D Films short work? What's the one thing he does that most copycat channels miss?

5. Availability: Your timezone, hours/week you can commit, and earliest start date.

Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. I'm hiring for attention to detail — your application is the first test.

We are a fast growing, results oriented Plaintiff Personal Injury law firm seeking a highly experienced Senior Case Manager to step into a high responsibility role. You will manage high value personal injury cases from intake through settlement and close out. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, coordinating medical treatment, managing complex insurance claims, preparing polished demand packages, and ensuring strict compliance with all deadlines.



We are looking for a true professional who thrives in a fast paced remote environment, communicates directly, and can manage a high volume of details without dropping the ball. If you are just looking to coast, this is not the job for you. If you are driven by results, value clear systems, and want to be rewarded for your hard work, we want to talk to you.



Key Responsibilities

Client Communication & Case Management:

• Serve as the primary client contact via phone,
, text, and client portal.

• Onboard new clients and clearly set expectations from day one.

• Provide regular case updates with empathy and professionalism.

• Maintain organized, highly detailed case notes and next actions in our case management system.



Insurance Claims & Coverage:

• Open and aggressively manage Bodily Injury, MedPay/PIP (if applicable), and UM/UIM claims.

• Rapidly obtain declarations pages, policy limits, and adjuster information.

• Request, track, and file UM/UIM Selection or Rejection Letters for applicable policies.

• Ensure complete and timely coverage verification for every file.



Deadlines & Compliance:

• Calendar and meticulously track California deadlines, including the 2 year statute of limitations and municipal/ante litem notice deadlines.

• Maintain a standard of zero missed deadlines and perfectly accurate documentation.



Medical Treatment & Records:

• Coordinate medical provider referrals under attorney direction.

• Monitor treatment progress and MMI status.

• Request, track, and strictly quality check HIPAA compliant medical records and bills.



Liens & Subrogation:

• Open and tightly manage Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, and private health insurance liens.

• Obtain final lien demands and assist with aggressive reductions.



Demands, Settlement & Close Out:

• Prepare highly polished demand packages, including liability summaries, damages narratives, medical specials spreadsheets, and supporting exhibits.

• Support settlement negotiations for high value cases under attorney supervision.

• Process settlements, releases, disbursements, and case close out checklists.



Performance Metrics (KPIs):

We use KPI tracking to reward high performers with bonuses, not for micromanagement. You will be measured on:

• Time from assignment to demand and settlement.

• Coverage completeness (UM/UIM letters and verified limits secured within 30 days).

• Medical records turnaround time and first pass completeness.

• Zero missed deadlines and clean CRM documentation.

• Time Zone Integrity: Strict adherence to 9 AM - 6 PM Pacific Time. You must be actively online, responsive, and working solely for our firm during these hours.



Qualifications:

• Proven plaintiff personal injury pre-suit case management experience.

• California PI experience is strongly preferred (or a rigorous willingness to learn CA specific rules).

• Deep working knowledge of UM/UIM, MedPay/PIP, medical billing terminology, and complex liens/subrogation.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

• Highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and tech savvy.

• Prior experience working effectively in a fast paced environment.

• Reliable, professional, and comfortable working completely independently in a remote setting.



Technology & Tools

• Experience with at least one major PI case management system (Filevine, Needles, SmartAdvocate, Lead Docket).

• Comfortable with Microsoft 365.

• Familiar with e-fax, e-signature tools, and VOIP systems.

(Training is provided for firm specific tools.)



Compensation & Benefits:

• $2,500 USD Monthly, paid bi-weekly. Negotiable depending on experience.

• 40 hour work week from 9 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time.

• Aggressive performance bonuses tied to KPIs (Up to $1,000 USD).

• Full time, long term position.

• An efficient team environment with well defined processes, direct collaboration with a U.S. attorney, and major opportunities for growth.



Why Join Our Firm

• Stable, long term remote role (not project based)

• Direct collaboration with U.S. attorney

• Well defined processes and realistic expectations

• Opportunity to grow with a plaintiff side personal injury practice



How to Apply:

To prove you have read this entire job description, you must start your application or
 subject line with the exact phrase: "California PI Closer - [Your Name]". Applications without this subject line will be immediately archived.



Workspace & Application Requirements:

To support a successful remote work environment and ensure you are set up for long term success, applicants MUST include the following in their proposal:

• A short Loom video introduction (2-3 minutes max). In this video, you MUST verbally answer Question #4 (The Furious Client scenario). Show us exactly how you would speak to this client to de-escalate the situation.

• A brief view of your dedicated workspace.

• A screenshot confirming your internet speed (Minimum: 50 Mbps Download) and computer specifications (Minimum: 8GB RAM, i5 processor or equivalent).

(These materials help us ensure long term success in a fully remote role.)



Answer the following questions when applying:

1. You have a California auto-collision file. The at-fault Geico policy is $15k/$30k. Your client's ER and physical therapy bills total $42,000, and they have an active ERISA health insurance lien. Walk me through your exact step-by-step strategy to get this file closed and put money in the client's pocket.



2. An adjuster from State Farm is refusing to tender a $100k policy limit, arguing that the client's MRI findings (a 3mm disc bulge) are degenerative and not related to the rear-end impact. What specific evidence and arguments are you putting in the demand letter to force them to pay?



3. You inherit a messy Filevine dashboard with 40 pre-litigation files. 10 are waiting on medical records, 5 are ready for demands, and 3 have upcoming statute of limitations deadlines in 60 days. How do you prioritize your first 48 hours on the job?



4. A client calls you absolutely furious. It’s been 8 months since their accident, they just finished treatment a week ago, and they are demanding to know why they don't have their settlement check yet. They threaten to fire the firm. Walk me through exactly how you handle this call, de-escalate the situation, and reset their expectations.



5. You get a new intake for an intersection collision. The police report incorrectly places your client 100% at fault, but your client insists the other driver ran a red light. The other driver is claiming your client ran the light. What are your immediate next steps to flip liability and find coverage?

Build integrations between Claude and ServiceM8 (via its REST API and MCP), 
, and n8n or similar

You Must Have

Strong spoken and written English

title: AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING
description:
**AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING**

Haven Noire | Full-Time | 5+ Years STR Experience Required



---



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. IF YOU DO NOT HAVE AIRBNB OR SHORT-TERM RENTAL EXPERIENCE, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.**



---



**QUICK FACTS**

- Type: Full-time, Remote

- Hours: 30 hrs/week | 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Mountain Standard Time | Weekends required

- Pay: $2.00/hr base + uncapped commission per signed arbitrage deal

- Experience: Minimum 5 years Airbnb / short-term rental management

- Cold Calling: 80–150+ outbound calls/day required

- Start: Immediate



---



**ABOUT US**



Haven Noire is a newly formed US-based short-term rental company building a portfolio of Airbnb arbitrage and co-managed properties across multiple US markets. We are in active growth mode — you are joining early, and your performance directly shapes how fast we scale and how much you earn.



We need someone who can do two things well: run flawless STR operations AND get on the phone to bring new properties into our portfolio. If you are a closer who also knows Airbnb inside out, this role was written for you.



---



**THE ROLE**



This is a dual-function position. You will own both sides of our operation: securing new properties through outbound cold calling, and running day-to-day Airbnb operations once those properties are live.



---



**PART 1 — BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & COLD CALLING**



Because we are a new operation, securing properties is the first priority. You will be the first voice property owners hear from Haven Noire. Your phone performance directly drives your commission — there is no cap.



What you will do:

- 80–150+ outbound cold calls daily to US property owners and landlords

- Pitch Haven Noire's Airbnb arbitrage and co-management services

- Qualify leads and book appointments for deal closing

- Follow up with warm leads via call, SMS, and

- Maintain clean CRM notes after every call

- Research target markets and build prospect lists based on our criteria

- Draft and send arbitrage pitch letters and follow-up sequences



Cold calling requirements:

- Excellent spoken English — clear, natural flow, light or neutral accent. Non-negotiable.

- Previous cold calling experience: real estate, SaaS, insurance, or similar outbound roles

- Experience with dialers: Mojo, CallTools, RingCentral, or equivalent

- Experience with CRMs: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or equivalent

- Thick skin and self-motivation

- Reliable internet (25+ Mbps), noise-canceling headset, quiet workspace



---



**PART 2 — AIRBNB & STR OPERATIONS**



Once properties are signed, you manage our listings end-to-end: guests, cleaners, maintenance, platform health, and account protection.



Guest communication:

- Handle all guest messaging: pre-booking, during stay, post-checkout

- Respond within Airbnb SLA windows to protect Superhost status

- Manage booking requests, special needs, and issue resolution



Turnover & maintenance:

- Coordinate cleaners to ensure on-time turnovers between every booking

- Schedule and track maintenance requests with vendors and building staff

- Monitor property tech: Ring cameras, smart locks, noise monitors



Platform & account management:

- Handle Airbnb support tickets, case escalations, and claim negotiations

- Manage listing health: pricing, availability, photos, and descriptions

- Submit review removal requests when warranted, manage review responses

- Protect host accounts from flags, suspensions, or policy violations



Reporting:

- Maintain daily logs of guest status, cleaning schedules, and open issues

- Weekly reporting on occupancy, revenue, and operational flags



---



**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**



You must meet all of the following. No exceptions.



- Minimum 5 years of direct Airbnb or short-term rental management experience

- Proven portfolio — you must be able to show listings you have managed (URLs, screenshots, or references)

- Deep knowledge of Airbnb platform policies, terms of service, and case management

- Experience communicating with Airbnb support and resolving escalations

- Strong written English for guest-facing communication

- Excellent spoken English for cold calling — natural, clear, confident

- Prior outbound cold calling experience with measurable results

- Available 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Mountain Standard Time, including weekends

- Reliable internet 25+ Mbps, headset, quiet workspace



---



**BONUS QUALIFICATIONS (not required)**



- Experience as an Airbnb case manager or platform specialist

- Managed 20+ active listings simultaneously

- Cold calling experience in real estate, property management, or Airbnb arbitrage

- Mid-term rental strategy experience (30-day stays, travel nurses, corporate)

- Familiar with Hospitable, Guesty, PriceLabs, Turno, or similar tools



---



**COMPENSATION**



Base: $2.00/hour. Commission: uncapped — every arbitrage deal you help close earns you a bonus on top of your base. As the portfolio grows, your base rate grows with it.



We are a new business and the base reflects that honestly. What we offer in return is an early seat at a scaling company, direct impact on your own earnings, and a commitment to raising your rate as you prove your value. Closers who perform will not stay at base for long.



---



**HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY**



Applications missing any of the five items below will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



1. Voice memo (2–3 min) in English: introduce yourself, walk through your cold calling background, share your biggest phone win, and explain why commission-based work motivates you.

2. Written summary of your cold calling experience — industries, daily dial volume, conversion rates, appointments booked. Be specific with numbers.

3. Proof of Airbnb/STR experience — listing URLs, dashboard screenshots, or verifiable client references.

4. Internet speed test screenshot showing 25+ Mbps.

5. Your expected base salary and any past commission structures you have earned under.



Subject line: **"I dial, I close — [Your Name]"**



Write **"HAVEN NOIRE READY"** at the top of your message to confirm you read this posting in full.



Incomplete applications will not receive a response.

title: Senior Video Editor - Direct Response Performance Ads - Headlamp Brand
description:
Senior Video Editor - Direct Response Performance Ads - Headlamp Brand



Job Overview

We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, already one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US to become the biggest globally. We scale through Meta paid ads and we're building our in-house creative team for the rest of 2026 and beyond.

We're looking for a video editor to join us. This is a long-term collaborative role with strong base pay, real performance bonuses on winning ads, and a clear growth path if you're an A-player.

Full-time preferred. Part-time considered for the right editor with strong availability through Q4.



About Us

We sell a product that genuinely makes people's lives better. The brand is founder-led, performance-driven, and growing fast. We have the strategy, the briefs, the creators, and the system already in place. What we need now is the right editor to execute at the level the brand and team deserves.

We're scaling our ad spend significantly through Q4, which means we need editors who can deliver clean, high-converting direct response ads at speed without compromising quality.

Focused on understanding the stories and narratives we create and turning them into great ads. 



What You'll Be Doing

You'll be editing UGC ads, Voiceover ads, founder-style content, mashups, and AI-assisted ads - all designed to convert. The output is direct response performance creative, not branded content. We care about hooks, retention, pacing, narrative, and clarity. The ads that spend the most for us are simple, natural, and don't feel like ads at all.

A big part of the role is reviewing our top-spending ads, understanding why they work, and using that to iterate on what we make next. We build feedback loops here - every brief is better than the last, and every editor on the team gets sharper with each ad they cut. You'll have briefs, creator footage, and the support of the team to do your best work.

You'll work directly with the team to learn and improve what's working to drive the quality in the right direction. Communication is in English via Slack.



What We're Looking For

An editor who understands narrative, story, and direct response - and can read the type of ad and the concept we've built, and edit it in the way that fits it best. Creating ads that resonate with REAL PEOPLE. 

Specifically:

- Strong portfolio of DTC/eCommerce ads that genuinely performed on Meta or TikTok

- Deep understanding of hook craft, retention, pacing, and how ads convert

- Fluent in UGC editing - clean, natural, organic feel

- Experience in mashup, founder-style, and ugly ads

- AI-fluent - we use ElevenLabs for voiceover, Higgsfield for AI B-roll, Nano Banana for images, and we're always exploring new tools

- High-level written and spoken English

- Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time

- Able to deliver finished ads at a steady pace - typically 2-3 per day at peak (more if possible). 

- Cares about quality and craft, not just output volume

We're pro-AI here. We still love real content and real creators - AI helps the workflow and the output. If you can combine craft with speed and AI fluency, you'll thrive here.



What This Pays

Base rate: $35 USD per finished ad.



Paid per brief delivered to standard. Strong volume of briefs available, especially through Q4.



Plus performance bonuses on winning ads.



We pay real bonuses when ads you cut scale. Our top ads last year individually spent over $100,000+ each - and Q4 is when the biggest bonuses get paid out. The structure is genuinely favourable: editors who deliver winners can earn meaningful additional income on top of base, especially during the Q4 ramp.



Full bonus structure shared once you pass the paid test brief.



Growth Path

This is a long-term role. The editor who delivers in Q4 becomes the senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression - more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, and direct collaboration on creative direction.



How to Apply

We're running a structured application process. Don't reply to this post - applications go through our application form here:





The form takes 10-15 minutes. We're looking for editors who take it seriously and answer in their own words. 



If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand and creators. From there, the right editor joins the team and starts cutting paid work within the week.



A Final Word

An editor who chases volume and doesn't care about hook craft, engagement, or story - we're not the brand for you.

If you're an editor who cares about every cut, every caption, every beat - who wants to be part of a serious team building one of the biggest brands in our space - apply through the form. We'll come back to you.

title: Social Media Marketing Coordinator
description:

We are an education and training company in the healthcare space seeking a highly organized, creative, and collaborative Social Media Marketing Coordinator to support the growth and visibility of our programs and professional community.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys translating expert ideas into engaging, professional social media content and helping build meaningful online engagement within healthcare and coaching communities.

About the Role

The Social Media Marketing Coordinator will work closely with our clinician educators and leadership team to develop and execute a consistent, high-quality social media presence across multiple platforms. This person will help transform ideas, educational insights, announcements, and program updates from our clinician tea
mbers into polished social media content that reflects our professional and mission-driven voice.



This role includes both strategic planning and day-to-day execution.



Core Responsibilities

• Develop and manage our social media marketing strategy

• Draft, edit, and publish content for LinkedIn, Instagram,
, and Doximity

• Monitor engagement and respond professionally to comments and discussions across platforms

• Ability to collaborate effectively with a team

• Experience developing and executing broader digital or social media marketing strategies

• Experience growing audience engagement and brand visibility across multiple platforms

• Experience creating marketing campaigns, promotional content, or educational marketing content

• Familiarity with content planning, audience targeting, and marketing analytics

• Experience working in healthcare, medical education, coaching, or professional education environments
